label: Label Lens
summary: Reads food and medicine labels from a photo and checks them against the user's allergies and medications. Every AI warning quotes the label word for word (44 of 44 verified).

label: Autonomous Supply Chain Watchtower
summary: Multi-agent LLM system: three agents in sequence on the Anthropic Claude API through CrewAI turn sales history into a logistics plan. The Risk Analyst is grounded in real shipping-disruption data over ChromaDB.
metrics: 3 agents in sequence on the Claude API

label: Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization
summary: MS capstone, team of four: demand forecasts across 250 SKU and warehouse series with a strict time-based test window. 27.7% WAPE against a 38.5% naive baseline, turned into a reorder-point policy.
metrics: 27.7% WAPE vs. 38.5% naive baseline; about 28% lower simulated holding cost

label: End-to-End CI/CD Deployment Pipeline
summary: Multi-tier AWS environment in Terraform, parameterized so one codebase deploys dev or prod. GitHub Actions tests every push to main, builds a Docker image, pushes to ECR, and triggers a Terraform deploy.

label: WLAN Traffic Forensics Toolkit
summary: Parses 100,000+ WPA2-encrypted packets, rebuilds the network topology as a directed graph, and classifies device types with K-Means. A Z-score detector caught a live deauthentication attack.

label: F1 Race Outcome Predictor
summary: Ranks drivers by win probability with rolling features shifted forward to prevent look-ahead leakage. 52% top-1 and 80% top-3 accuracy on 44 held-out races, against a 43% / 73% baseline.

label: Containerized Flask Service on Kubernetes
summary: Flask API with Postgres and Redis in a multi-stage Dockerfile, run locally through docker-compose and deployed to a local kind cluster.

label: Real-Time Group Chat Application
summary: Multi-client chat in Core Java. A server handles concurrent TCP socket connections and broadcasts messages, with client and server code kept modular.

label: Hand Gesture Controlled RC Car
summary: B.Tech major project, team of three: an RC car steered by hand gestures read by an ADXL335 accelerometer and sent over RF. Arduino C++, L298 motor driver, IR obstacle detection, tested in Gazebo.
